5: Explicit action and concrete details on how to implement

"2. I'm concerned about the effect-boosting effect of the proposed method on different datasets. Since the improvment is not large. The authors know they should do hypothesis testing but not exactly how (which test, on what data, etc.). The comment doesn't provide details on how to implement — e.g., which statistical test to use, how to investigate the phenomenon. So the rationale misapplies the rubric by conflating "explicit action" with "concrete implementation details."
